question.question: Can ownership of faction pieces change, and are items faction pieces that belong to the faction holding them?

expected.expected_answer: Faction piece ownership cannot change; starting faction owns its listed faction pieces except items. Items are not faction pieces and are not owned by a faction.

source_passages.quotation: Items are not faction pieces or enemy pieces. **Faction-piece ownership cannot change**: each player owns the faction chosen in setup and its listed faction pieces, except items; possessing an item does not make it faction-owned.

answer.ruling: Faction-piece ownership cannot change: each player owns the faction chosen in setup and the faction pieces listed for it, apart from items.
Items are not faction pieces or enemy pieces. Possessing an item does not make it faction-owned.
